name: dsh-stock
description: Read-only market queries for DeepSeek Harness: twelve Host tools (stock_search, stock_quote, stock_kline, stock_minute, stock_bars, stock_minute_history, stock_moneyflow, stock_fundamentals, stock_market, stock_rank, stock_news, stock_macro) over public Tencent and East Money endpoints, with request serialization, per-host backoff, and bounded responses.
